mem.10:
27 Mar 2023: Audrey and Andrew caught up; Andrew had started a Financial Analyst job the week before. Audrey had dogs for three years and shared a photo of two wearing new collars. Her dogs: Pepper, Precious, Panda (later also Pixie); she adores them and takes them to parks and trails. Andrew has no pet, loves animals and is fascinated by eagles; shared birds silhouetted against sun. He spots birds hiking but hasn’t bird-watched. Recommended Fox Hollow; Audrey planned to try it.

2 Apr: Audrey’s household adopted Pixie, a small white puppy; she took a few days to adjust, then bonded with Pepper. Audrey shared dog photos. She hadn’t visited Fox Hollow due to puppy care. Andrew considered adopting but struggled to find pet-friendly city housing; Audrey suggested housing-site pet filters. He missed hiking with his family’s dog and shared trail photos. Audrey hoped to hike with her dogs; Andrew would update her about housing.

16 Apr: Andrew and girlfriend tried a city cafe; he liked it but missed nature/hiking. Nature makes him feel connected, at home in his soul, and helps him reset. Audrey said dog walks ground and recharge her. They enjoy city food spots; shared bakery treats/coffee and blueberry muffins, and planned a pastry party with dogs. Audrey shared dogs running, plus her dog-and-sunflowers tattoo: love of pups/nature and a way to see their faces when away; also shared dog-walking-in-woods photo.

3 May: Audrey hiked and saw a hummingbird (photo perched on branch, wings spread). Andrew found nearby open space and tries to hike weekly; shared sunset over lake and mountains. Nature is therapeutic, peaceful, invigorating; he likes capturing special moments. Audrey shared dogs in field/playing. Dogs love hikes, scents, nature; she prioritizes safety (shoes, leash), plays fetch with balls/frisbees, visits dog parks/playdates. Energetic, toy-loving dogs wear party hats for fun/treats. Recommended a wooded dog park with benches (photo dog jumping through ring); Andrew would visit.

5–6 May: Andrew searched for a dog via websites, shelters, friends; fun but frustrating (shared dog peering through cage). Audrey shared dogs running in field, one with ball. Andrew advised matching breed exercise needs to space; a smaller dog might suit his apartment. Pet-friendly housing still hard; contacting landlords, seeking area near park/woods. 5 May Audrey took dogs on a road trip to a national park (photo three running in grass); they do this every couple months. Andrew added furry-companion road trip to bucket list.

11 May: Andrew hiked with friends and girlfriend; shared path to grassy hill. Audrey had four dogs and signed up for positive-reinforcement bonding/training workshop next month after seeing flyer at pet store and meeting volunteer’s friendly dog. She believes in rewards, not punishment; hurting dogs pains her. Andrew agreed and asked for tips/update.

2 Jun: Audrey took pups to park, ran/played off leash; joyful and peaceful. Andrew shared mountain sunset with grazing horse. Audrey said she’d hiked with dogs at national park previous week, reached peak at sunset; breeze, birdsong and dogs felt like paradise. Shared favorite photo described as two horses in fenced field despite hike context. Nature cheers her and inspires gratitude. Andrew discouraged but persistent over housing; Audrey offered to search if he emailed criteria.

13 Jun: Andrew took rock-climbing class with friends Sunday, reached top, loved it, planned weekly outdoor activities. Shared summit view and man on rock face. Newbie found it tricky; friends’ cheering helped, felt proud. Interested in kayaking, perhaps bungee jumping; nature gets him outside comfort zone. Audrey found wooded small park trail, invited him and dogs; he accepted. Dogs enjoy people. Walks usually ~hour, varying at dogs’ pace; they return happy/tired. Dogs/nature are her happy place; outdoors brings joy, peace, inspiration. Andrew agrees it calms, inspires, refreshes.

26 Jun: Audrey moved to place with bigger backyard (photo two dogs on lawn); set up agility equipment/toys. Andrew shared dogs playing at nearby indoor doggy daycare; Audrey might check it out; he offered help finding dog-friendly places. Both see pets as family; Audrey can’t understand people who hate/hurt pets. Andrew shared flower bed in neighborhood park. Audrey unpacking. Andrew hiked with friends previous Friday, enjoyed birdsong/tree smell, hadn’t reviewed photos; missed nature’s peace. Audrey shared photo of feet on rock overlooking lake and recalled a memorable lake hike with friends years ago, sitting/chatting; shared person sitting on rock by lake. It soothed her; both valued small things and not taking life for granted.

3 Jul 2023: Audrey was taking dog-training course; challenging but rewarding, dogs improving, consuming time and limiting new trails. Andrew still couldn’t find dog-friendly rental, said life had thrown curveballs; doing urban adventures and finding hobbies while unable to hike. Audrey shared dogs running with ball; all are mutts, two Jack Russell mixes, two Chihuahua mixes; love running/fetch. Dog-bed photo. All four are 3 years old and a great pack; playdate previous Friday was crazy but fun; couch/blanket photo. Audrey called them her universe.

Andrew was getting into cooking/trying recipes. Audrey loves cooking as creative escape and stress relief; favorite is chicken pot pie, family recipe passed down for years, reminds her of grandma’s kitchen and table conversations. Shared pie photos, including lattice crust; offered recipe. Both find cooking relaxing/creative and enjoy eating afterward. Audrey likes music, a glass of wine, and improvising in kitchen; calls cooking self-care/therapeutic. Shared vegetable-heavy plate. Garlic is her go-to ingredient. Favorite garlic dish: roasted chicken, based on Mediterranean flavors; chicken, garlic, lemon, herbs, healthy/easy, her comfort meal. Shared chicken-and-potatoes pan photo and offered recipe; Andrew planned to try both recipes and report back. Conversation ended with friendly goodbyes.
mem.19:
27 Mar 2023: Audrey and Andrew caught up. Andrew had started a Financial Analyst job the prior week. Audrey has dogs Pepper, Precious, Panda, and later Pixie; shared dog/bird photos. Andrew has no pet then, loves animals/eagles, sees birds hiking but hasn’t tried birdwatching. Audrey recommended Fox Hollow; Andrew planned to visit.

2 Apr: Audrey’s household adopted small white puppy Pixie, who bonded with Pepper. Andrew considered adopting but struggled to find pet-friendly city housing; Audrey suggested rental-site pet filters. He missed hiking with his family’s dog.

16 Apr–3 May: Andrew and girlfriend tried a city cafe; he missed nature/hiking, which make him feel at home, connected and refreshed. Audrey says dog walks ground/recharge her. They discussed treats, coffee, muffins and a dog-friendly pastry party. Audrey shared her dog-and-sunflowers tattoo and woods-walk photo. Both find nature peaceful/therapeutic. Audrey’s dogs like hikes, scents, fetch, parks and playdates; she prioritizes safety with shoes/leash and recommended a wooded dog park. She shared a hummingbird photo; Andrew a lake/mountain sunset.

5–6 May–2 Jun: Andrew searched websites, shelters and friends for a dog, weighing exercise needs, small-apartment breeds, landlords and nearby parks/woods; fun but frustrating. Audrey road-trips with dogs to a national park every couple months; Andrew added a companion road trip to his bucket list. Audrey signed up for positive-reinforcement dog training/bonding workshop; favors rewards over punishment. She later offered to search housing if Andrew sent criteria; he remained discouraged but persistent.

13 Jun–8 Jul: Andrew took beginner rock-climbing class, reached the top, loved it and planned weekly outdoor activities; interested in kayaking, maybe bungee jumping. Audrey invited him and dogs to wooded trail; he accepted. Audrey moved to a place with bigger backyard, agility equipment/toys; Andrew’s dogs went to nearby indoor daycare. Audrey was taking dog-training classes: challenging/rewarding, dogs improving, but fewer new trails. Her four dogs are mutts: two Jack Russell mixes, two Chihuahua mixes; love running, fetch, playdates; she calls them her universe. Andrew got into cooking. Audrey cooks creatively for self-care/stress relief, with music and wine, improvises and uses garlic. Favorites: family chicken pot pie recipe passed down years (connected to grandma), and roasted chicken with garlic, lemon, herbs. They shared recipes/photos. Andrew picnicked with girlfriend 7 Jul; sought leash-free parks. Audrey proposed August hike; they shared trail/park/sunset photos. An earlier sunset hike was ~3-hour drive, location unspecified.

11–27 Jul: Andrew adopted German Shepherd puppy Toby despite city living; work kept Toby inside and Andrew missed hiking. Audrey suggested hike together; Andrew invited her next month and she accepted. Audrey makes personalized wooden dog tags/keychains. Andrew and girlfriend volunteered at pet shelter on Monday; rewarding, joyful; Audrey might volunteer. Audrey described dogs’ birth-order personalities: oldest relaxed/wise, second playful, third naughty but cuddly, youngest lively/adventurous. Childhood dog Max loved fetch; Audrey took long walks and shared worries/hopes with him. They value pets’ unconditional, nonjudgmental companionship.

4–24 Aug: Andrew, girlfriend and Toby planned camping; Audrey began park agility classes twice weekly. Andrew shared Toby jumping through ring. Audrey’s dog hike took 2 hours with beautiful views; nature is refuge, makes worries vanish; pets helped her through hard times. Andrew hopes for deep bond with Toby; Audrey advises time, attention, walks/exercise. Andrew took Toby on small local hike. Audrey got tattoo of four dogs to keep them with her; described arm, photo description hand. Andrew/girlfriend visited farm for vegetables. Audrey would like more dogs but four enough; vet visits chaotic, next time one at a time. Favorite dog resting spots: Pepper couch, Pixie bed, Precious chair, Panda rug. Dogs nap together/best friends. They shared lounging/outdoor photos and say pets are family. Andrew visited cafe during work break and shared sunset mountain with church atop. Audrey learned grooming in course, grooms dogs herself; tips: slowly/gently, watch ears/paws, patience/positivity. Andrew went fishing with girlfriend at nearby lake, caught a few; Audrey never fished but likes sitting peacefully by mountain lake listening to birds. Audrey’s care routine: daily brushing, regular baths, nail trims and love. Andrew wants strong bond with Toby, initially wanted to figure things out himself; they look forward to adventures.

6 Sep: Andrew’s work stressful; outdoor activities took backseat and balance was hard. Audrey encouraged self-care, does at least one daily thing for herself. Andrew added morning coffee/lunch walks. Audrey organized neighbor-dog playdate; dogs’ joy made her heart full. Bought cozy beds for cooler weather; dogs love snuggling. Andrew hiked previous weekend, relieved to escape city, shared mountain/city sunset photo. Toby still too young for hiking. Andrew still hadn’t found dog-friendly housing; Audrey urged him not to give up.

24 Sep 2023: Audrey said previous Friday at park one pup pulled so hard leash broke; she chased and caught her before harm. Andrew worried and asked how she calmed her; she petted/hugged, spoke calmly and walked dog slowly. Andrew wants that bond with Toby. Audrey advises patience, regular training, love, time and praise; trains obedience/tricks (sit, stay, shake, roll over), walks dogs multiple times daily for exercise/bonding. Reconfirmed two Jack Russell mixes/two Chihuahua mixes; said breeds may affect bonding. Audrey shared many dog photos; says they bring joy, mean everything and she can’t imagine life without them. Andrew shared balcony flowers he was caring for. Audrey has small garden; flowers and veggie patch growing, finds gardening peaceful/accomplishing. Peruvian lilies are bright/delicate, easy to care for: water and enough sun. Dogs run around/explore garden; only play with her own dogs.

Both found nature therapeutic. Audrey’s dogs liked hikes, scents, fetch and playdates; she emphasized shoes/leash safety and recommended a wooded dog park.

5 May–2 Jun: Andrew searched shelters, sites and friends for a dog, considering exercise, apartment breeds, landlords and parks. Audrey road-tripped with her dogs to a national park every couple of months; Andrew added a companion road trip to his bucket list. She offered to search housing if he sent criteria. He remained discouraged but persistent.

13 Jun–8 Jul: Andrew took a beginner climbing class, reached the top, and planned weekly outdoor activities; interested in kayaking and possibly bungee jumping. Audrey invited him and dogs to a wooded trail. She moved somewhere with a bigger backyard, agility equipment and toys; dogs also attended indoor daycare. Andrew got into cooking. Audrey cooks creatively for self-care, with music and wine, improvising and using garlic. Favorites: family chicken pot pie (grandmother’s recipe) and roasted chicken with garlic, lemon and herbs. They shared recipes/photos. Andrew picnicked with girlfriend 7 Jul and sought leash-free parks. Audrey proposed an August hike and shared trail/park/sunset photos; one sunset hike was about a three-hour drive, location unknown.

11–27 Jul: Andrew adopted German Shepherd puppy Toby; city/work kept him indoors and he missed hiking. Audrey makes personalized wooden dog tags/keychains. Andrew and girlfriend volunteered at a pet shelter one Monday. Audrey might volunteer. She described dogs’ birth-order personalities: oldest relaxed/wise, second playful, third naughty but cuddly, youngest lively/adventurous. Childhood dog Max loved fetch; Audrey shared worries with him on long walks.

4–24 Aug: Andrew, girlfriend and Toby planned camping. Audrey started park agility classes twice weekly; Andrew shared Toby jumping through a ring. Audrey’s two-hour dog hike had beautiful views; nature was refuge and pets helped through hard times. Andrew took Toby on a small local hike. Audrey got a tattoo of all four dogs. Andrew and girlfriend visited a vegetable farm and fished at a nearby lake. Audrey felt four dogs were enough; vet visits were chaotic, so next time one at a time. Resting spots: Pepper couch, Pixie bed, Precious chair, Panda rug; they napped together. Audrey advised patient, attentive bonding and taught grooming: gentle handling, watch ears/paws, daily brushing, baths/nail trims, positive reinforcement. Andrew initially wanted to figure Toby out himself.

6–24 Sep: Andrew’s work was stressful; morning coffee and lunch walks helped balance life. Audrey encouraged self-care, arranged a neighbor-dog playdate and bought cozy beds. Andrew hiked/shared mountain-city sunset; Toby was too young to hike. Andrew still struggled to find dog-friendly housing. One Friday a dog pulled hard and broke its leash; Audrey chased and caught it, then soothed it with pets, hugs, calm voice and a slow walk. She trains sit/stay/shake/roll over and walks dogs several times daily. Her small garden/vegetable patch was peaceful; dogs explored it but only played with her dogs. Peruvian lilies are bright, delicate and easy-care.

1–19 Oct: Andrew and girlfriend planned Toby’s beach trip for November; Audrey had taken dogs swimming/playing at a beach. Audrey suggested houseplants or weekend parks when city/work blocked outdoor time; Andrew preferred outdoors but might try plants. Audrey read a birdwatching guide; Andrew offered to go together with binoculars/notebook. They discussed nature’s interconnectedness and protecting it. Audrey recycles, usually takes transit; Andrew suggested biking/public transit and offered river routes. Audrey resumed walks after knee injury. Audrey makes jewelry from recycled bottle caps, buttons and broken jewelry, sells it and donates some proceeds to an animal shelter. Andrew and girlfriend played board games with Toby on a Tuesday; Audrey bought dog toys the prior Monday. Andrew adopted shelter puppy Buddy; Toby needed time to accept him. Andrew planned trails with both; Audrey looked forward to a hike next month and offered to research one. Andrew shared rural dirt-road photos with a cow/red truck; location unknown.

24–28 Oct: Andrew and girlfriend went wine tasting; he liked unusual wines and trying new things. Audrey had a park accident the prior week and broke an arm; cast made dog care one-handed but manageable, improving daily. Andrew tried sushi and liked it; Audrey loves sushi and recommended California/salmon rolls, sauces and variety. On 28 Oct Audrey said dogs had acted unusually; animal behaviorist had visited the prior Wednesday, assessed them and suggested handling/routine changes. Audrey used positive reinforcement; dogs were progressing. All four are mutts: Pepper/Panda Lab mixes, Precious/Pixie Chihuahua mixes (contradicts an earlier claim of two Jack Russell and two Chihuahua mixes). Andrew shared national-park mountain-hiking and nearby dog-friendly-trail photos with “killer views”; they agreed to hike Saturday with snacks. Andrew had a Sunday picnic date with girlfriend; selected a peaceful lakeside trail.

4 Nov: Andrew/girlfriend biked to a park outside town. Audrey likes discovering parks with her four dogs and joined a weekly dog-owners group for tips/play; shared photos. Andrew considered a third dog but was unsure; Audrey advised prioritizing Toby and Buddy’s happiness/health, said they didn’t need more dogs to be happy, and offered help. Andrew felt he’d made city dog ownership work. Audrey recommended daily activity, socialization and mental stimulation; shared toy-basket and fetch photos.

22 Nov: Audrey’s four dogs went to a pet salon the previous Friday, were excited but behaved well; she shared a grooming photo and was glad they settled in. Andrew and girlfriend hadn’t yet groomed their dogs. Andrew adopted a third dog, Scout, despite earlier uncertainty; shared a photo described as a woman feeding a dog hay in a barn. They planned a nearby park visit with Scout, Toby and Buddy; Audrey advised starting small and keeping Scout leashed. Andrew had bought Scout a bed, toys and puppy pads as a safe space; Audrey recommended gradual introductions to Toby and Buddy. Audrey’s dogs were doing well, exploring and meeting people. Both said dogs bring joy, friendship and are family.
